marketing.title: Nodo CRM
marketing.description: The CRM for businesses that quote and deliver projects: leads, quotes your customers accept online, and every project through to done, under your own name.

hero.title: Quote it. Win it. Get stuck in.
hero.subtitle: Leads, quotes your customers accept online, and every project through to done, all under your own name.

enquiries.title: Catch every lead
enquiries.body: Enquiries land straight from your website, the right person hears about it, and every one gets a next step. No more digging through the inbox.
enquiries.phoneAlt: The list of leads in Nodo

form.title: Your website, wired in
form.body: Paste one snippet and every enquiry lands in Nodo, with spam and duplicates filtered out.

person.title: They come back. You remember.
person.body: Returning customers are recognised by their email, with every past project and quote right there.

tasks.title: Follow up on time, every time
tasks.body: Give every lead a next step with a date. The bell nudges you when one runs late.

pipeline.title: A pipeline that updates itself
pipeline.body: Send the quote and the lead moves to proposal. They say yes, it's won. No dragging cards around.

quotes.title: Quotes that close
quotes.body: Write it once, send one link, and watch it being read.

build.title: Build
build.body: Itemised or in sections, with optional extras and a choice of options.

share.title: Share
share.body: One link with your branding, and you see the moment it is opened.
share.alt: The quote as the customer opens it

accept.title: Accept
accept.body: Signed on their phone, with the PDF ready to download.
accept.alt: A customer accepting and signing a quote

jobs.title: From yes to done
jobs.body: One button turns the accepted quote into a job: its crew, its dates, its photos and its chat in one place, all the way to handover.

schedule.title: Schedule & Lineup
schedule.body: Every job on one timeline. Drag a bar to move its dates.
schedule.label: Schedule

people.title: Only their jobs
people.body: Your crew sees the jobs they're on, never the prices.
people.label: Crew added

board.title: Message Board
board.body: The daily report, with photos and comments, where everyone can find it.
board.label: Message Board

files.title: Docs & Files
files.body: Photos straight from the phone, shrunk before they upload.
files.label: Photos

todos.title: To-dos
todos.body: Your crew ticks them off. The dates stay where you put them.
todos.label: To-do done

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Quick talk for the crew. Only an @mention rings.
chat.label: Chat

done.title: Handed over
done.body: Every photo, note and to-do stays on the job, ready for the next time they call.
done.label: Job completed

rows.title: Your name. Your customer. Your numbers.

brand.title: Your brand, not ours
brand.body: Your own address, logo and colours on the quote, the emails and the PDF. Go on, try yours:

live.title: Watch it land
live.body: See the moment it's opened, answer questions on the quote itself, and let the follow-ups send themselves. If the customer writes, they stop.

followUp.title: Follow-up sent
followUp.detail: On its own, when you said it should

message.title: Sarah wrote
message.detail: “Could the paint go on in March?”
message.note: Follow-ups paused: she's talking to you

numbers.title: Know your numbers
numbers.body: What you sent, what was won and what was turned down, how long customers take to decide, and the funnel from enquiry to won.

nz.title: Made for New Zealand
nz.body: GST in or on top, NZD, and prices shown the way the Fair Trading Act asks.

private.title: Your prices stay yours
private.body: Every company works in its own space. Nobody else ever sees your customers or your rates.

sign.title: Signed from their phone
sign.body: Customers accept and sign wherever they are, with the PDF ready to download.

founders.title: The people behind Nodo
founders.body: [Placeholder] Two or three sentences about who you are, why you built Nodo, and the trade business it started with.
founders.name: [Founder name]

cta.title: Your next job starts here
cta.body: Create your company in a minute and send your first quote today.

SALES.description: Works their own book: their leads and their quotes.

VIEWER.description: Views the company's information without being able to change it.

PROJECT_LEAD.description: Runs jobs end to end: opens them, puts the team together and sets the dates.

TEAM_LEAD.name: Team lead
TEAM_LEAD.description: Leads a crew on site: organises the to-dos and the schedule of their jobs.

WORKER.name: Worker

COLLABORATOR.name: Outside collaborator
